terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.required: You must accept the Terms and Conditions to continue.

body.p1: By accessing ChatGDCE, you agree to use this customs AI assistant only for lawful purposes related to customs, trade, and regulatory information.
body.p2: You are responsible for safeguarding your account credentials and for all activity under your account. Do not share sensitive personal data unless required for your customs workflow.
body.p3: Responses are provided for guidance and must be verified against official regulations, notices, and procedures issued by the General Department of Customs and Excise of Cambodia.
body.p4: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of the service after changes are published constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.

intro.beforeLinks: ChatGDCE believes in transparent data practices. Learn how your information is protected when using ChatGDCE, and visit our

retention.title: Chat retention policy
retention.description: This browser keeps a temporary chat cache for up to 7 days. The organization retains server data according to the following policy:
retention.activeChats: Chats and messages: 90 days after last activity.
retention.deletedChats: Deleted chats, their messages, and chat-only files: permanently purged after 30 days.
retention.projectFiles: Project files: retained while the project is active; permanently purged 30 days after project deletion.
